DUPLICATE_COVERAGE.description: Another test already covers the same behaviour.

OBSOLETE_BEHAVIOUR.description: The behaviour the test asserted no longer exists.

RENAMED_TEST.description: The test id changed while the assertion moved to a new id.

MERGED_TEST.description: The test was merged into a broader test.

FIXTURE_ONLY.description: The removed test exercised a fixture, not a behaviour. Proof-required: covered_by must name an added test.

FLAKY_QUARANTINE.description: The test is removed from the gate and replaced by a deterministic test.

POLICY_PROHIBITED.description: The test is prohibited by policy. Proof-required: covered_by must name an added test, even when the test cannot be replaced.
POLICY_PROHIBITED.compliance_alternative_note: Alternative considered: gate POLICY_PROHIBITED behind explicit compliance approval instead of covered_by proof. Rejected; decision is proof-required for every code including POLICY_PROHIBITED.

SECURITY_REGRESSION.description: The test asserted vulnerable behaviour and is replaced by a safe assertion.

enforcement.proof_rule: EVERY reason_code (including FIXTURE_ONLY and POLICY_PROHIBITED) requires a non-empty covered_by that EXACTLY equals an added test id (string equality after stripping; no substring or prefix matching); null, missing, or empty covered_by is REJECTED as TEST_REMOVAL_UNCOVERED
